messages.subject: amazing post-doc in quantitative ecology at Cornell University at New York Coop unit.
parts:
Angela Fuller is looking for a quantitative ecologist at Cornell University. The position concerns hierarchical modeling and bat monitoring for estimation of trends and abundance using bioacoustics. Knowledge of bats is optional but the person has to be a good analyst. Cornell is awesome, and the New York coop unit is a great place to be.  See attached flyer. Contact Angela Fuller directly. 
 Position starts as soon as a suitable candidate is identified.
